method: Actual compiled DLL pause code and installed game callbacks in Unicorn; DirectSound COM methods and WinMM volume calls stubbed with playback/refcount semantics.

results.case: Stops actual playing voices even when original active flag is zero; ignores stopped buffers and deduplicates aliases
Ends already sounding MIDI notes on all 16 channels without relying on broken CoreAudio volume calls
Continue restores original looping and one-shot flags, leaves previously silent buffers silent, releases references
Leaves MIDI volume and queued stream buffers untouched
Repeated pause/continue has no retained-reference leak
Quit never replays old race audio or changes MIDI volume
No music handle requires no MIDI operations
Unexpected song object type does not touch a MIDI handle
Compiled pause enter/leave thunks preserve original callbacks and calling convention
